type.name: state_event
type.layout: subscription_id:u32,phase:u8,flags:u8,reserved:u16=0,from_revision:u64,to_revision:u64,record_count:u16,repeated typed_record; SNAPSHOT_END may carry the final snapshot records, which are applied before completion; SNAPSHOT_BEGIN and RESET require record_count=0

types.name: frame_header
types.layout: family:u16,kind:u16,meta:u8,request_id:u32 if class request/result

types.name: result_prefix
types.layout: status:u16,flags:u16=0,detail:bytes_u32,body:remaining

types.name: client_hello
types.layout: minor_range,receive_limits,client_instance:[u8;16],client_name:string_u16,client_release:string_u16,family_offers,codecs,Extensions

types.name: server_hello
types.layout: minor:u16,reserved:u16=0,boot_id:[u8;16],session_id:[u8;16],receive_limits,times,names,family_descriptors,Extensions

types.name: family_descriptor
types.layout: descriptor:bytes_u32 containing family_id:u16,version:u16,runtime_state:u8,reserved:u8=0,operations,limits:bytes_u32; a known operation direction may be a nonempty supported subset of its canonical schema direction and must never add a forbidden direction

types.name: receive_limits
types.layout: max_frame:u32,max_decoded:u32,max_datagram:u32,max_buffered:u64; max_frame>=correlated_header_bytes,max_decoded>=max_frame,max_datagram=0 or >=event_header_bytes,max_buffered>0

types.name: family_operation
types.layout: direction:u8,class:u8 Request|Event only,kind:u16; Result capability is implied by Request

types.name: session_info
types.layout: session_id:[u8;16],catalog_revision:u64,ReceiveLimits,server_monotonic_ns:u64,family_count:u16,repeated FamilyDescriptor,Extensions

types.name: server_diagnostics_extension
types.layout: active_sessions:u32,relay_active:u32,relay_pending:u32,reserved:u32=0,aggregate_receive_limit:u64,aggregate_receive_buffered:u64; buffered<=limit

types.name: session_update
types.layout: catalog_revision:u64 nonzero,ReceiveLimits,Extensions; max_frame and max_decoded cannot decrease within a session

types.name: family_update
types.layout: catalog_revision:u64 nonzero,FamilyDescriptor; family_id and version match the selected descriptor

types.name: initial_watches_extension
types.layout: count:u16,repeated family_id:u16,family_version:u16,watch_payload:bytes_u32

types.name: initial_watch_results_extension
types.layout: count:u16,repeated embedded_watch_result:bytes_u32

types.name: negotiated_codecs_extension
types.layout: count:u8,repeated codec:u16; nonzero,unique,ascending,subset of ClientHello codecs

types.name: descriptor
types.layout: transfer_id:u32,mode:u8,direction:u8,flags:u16,receiver_send_credit:u64,sender_send_credit:u64,max_item_bytes:u64,max_chunk_bytes:u32,content_family:u16,content_kind:u16,content_version:u16,Extensions

types.name: message_limits_extension
types.layout: tag 1 max_open_messages:u32,nonzero,default 1

types.name: sensitive_content_extension
types.layout: required tag 2 with an empty value; DATA, MESSAGE_DATA, CLOSE, and RESET for the descriptor require the SENSITIVE frame flag

types.name: upload_stage_extension
types.layout: required tag 3 value staging_handle:u64,expires_server_ns:u64; the handle is scoped by the descriptor content_family; only on a sensitive receiver-to-sender BYTE upload descriptor; before the family commit succeeds, RESET of any descriptor atomically discards the entire stage and retires every sibling descriptor with the same content_family and staging handle; expiry or owning-session loss performs the same discard; CLOSE only seals one descriptor and never commits or discards the stage; expiry is nonzero and no more than 3600000000000 ns after descriptor creation

types.name: inline_or_transfer
types.layout: delivery:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,byte_len:u64,content_hash:[u8;32],inline data:bytes_u32 or TransferDescriptor

types.name: route_record
types.layout: route_handle:u64,generation:u64,availability:u8,transport_hint:u8,flags:u16,name:string_u16,label:string_u16,description:string_u32,Extensions

types.name: family_limits
types.layout: extension tags 1 max_routes:u32,2 max_links_per_session:u32,3 max_pending_connects:u32,4 max_early_data:u32,5 connect_timeout_ns:u64,6 max_buffered_per_link:u64

requests.name: READ
requests.layout: terminal_handle:u64,generation:u32,cursor_kind:u8,representation:u8,flags:u16=0,cursor_a:u64,cursor_b:u32,max_bytes:u32,initial_receive_credit:u64,Extensions; ABSOLUTE a=start oldest-relative row,b=max rows (zero through end); TAIL a=rows skipped from one-past-tail,b=max rows (zero through oldest); ResultPrefix + QueryBody

requests.name: SEARCH
requests.layout: terminal_handle:u64,generation:u32,flags:u16,reserved:u16=0,start_cursor:QueryCursor kind SEARCH_CURSOR_POSITION with a=oldest-relative row,b=column,max_results:u32,query:bytes_u32,initial_receive_credit:u64,Extensions; BACKWARD reverses traversal; result coordinates and next cursor are oldest-relative and end-exclusive; ResultPrefix + QueryBody

requests.name: JOURNAL
requests.layout: terminal_handle:u64,generation:u32,flags:u16,limit:u16,from_index:u64,initial_receive_credit:u64,Extensions; without TAIL from_index is an absolute command index; with TAIL it is records skipped back from next_index; ResultPrefix + QueryBody

requests.name: OUTPUT
requests.layout: terminal_handle:u64,generation:u32,cursor_kind:u8,flags:u8=0,reserved:u16=0,cursor_a:u64,cursor_b:u32,max_bytes:u32,initial_receive_credit:u64,Extensions; COMMAND a=index,b=column; LATEST_COMMAND a=0,b=column; SEQUENCE and PROBE a=sequence,b=column; ResultPrefix + QueryBody

requests.name: WAIT
requests.layout: terminal_handle:u64,generation:u32,wait_kind:u8,flags:u8=0,reserved:u16=0,cursor_a:u64,cursor_b:u32,max_bytes:u32,timeout_ns:u64,needle:bytes_u32,initial_receive_credit:u64,Extensions; OUTPUT uses a=sequence,b=column and nonempty needle and returns OutputResult; COMMAND uses a=index,b=0 and empty needle; LATEST_COMMAND uses a=b=0 and empty needle; command waits return one-record JournalResult; ResultPrefix + QueryBody

requests.name: COPY_RANGE
requests.layout: terminal_handle:u64,generation:u32,representation:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,start_row:i64,start_col:u32,end_row:i64,end_col:u32,max_bytes:u32,initial_receive_credit:u64,Extensions; rows are inclusive oldest-retained coordinates with negative values relative to one-past-tail, end_col is exclusive; ResultPrefix + QueryBody

requests.name: SEARCH_CATALOG
requests.layout: max_results:u32 in 1..=MAX_QUERY_RECORDS,query:string_u32 UTF-8 <= MAX_CATALOG_SEARCH_QUERY_BYTES,Extensions; server trims query and performs a case-insensitive regex search across every terminal title, visible grid, and scrollback; invalid or empty regex returns no entries; ResultPrefix + CatalogSearchResult

types.name: terminal_state_record
types.layout: terminal_handle:u64,lifecycle:u8,reserved:u8=0,rows:u16,cols:u16,generation:u32,used_rows:u32,Extensions

types.name: launch
types.layout: command_kind:u8,cwd_kind:u8,environment_base:u8,reserved:u8=0,command_variant,cwd_variant,environment_count:u16,repeated key:bytes_u16,entry_kind:u8,value:bytes_u32,Extensions

types.name: create_result
types.layout: terminal_handle:u64,state_revision:u64,generation:u32,reserved:u32=0,Extensions

types.name: restart_result
types.layout: state_revision:u64,generation:u32,reserved:u32=0

types.name: open_view_result
types.layout: view_id:u32,codec_version:u16,max_inflight_frames:u8,reserved:u8=0,max_encoded_frame:u32,max_decoded_frame:u32,first_sequence:u32,Extensions

types.name: initial_view_request
types.layout: rows:u16,cols:u16,max_fps:u16,codec_count:u8,reserved:u8=0,repeated codec_version:u16,Extensions

types.name: view_feedback
types.layout: view_id:u32,presented_sequence:u32,decoder_queue_depth:u8,available_frame_slots:u8

types.name: presentation_metrics
types.layout: viewport_width_px:u32,viewport_height_px:u32,cell_width_16_16:u32,cell_height_16_16:u32,device_scale_16_16:u32

types.name: exit_record
types.layout: kind:u8,reason:u8,reserved:u16=0,code:i32,detail:string_u32

types.name: search_results
types.layout: count:u32,repeated start_row:u64,start_col:u32,end_row:u64,end_col:u32,preview:string_u32; rows are oldest-retained and ranges end-exclusive

types.name: catalog_search
types.layout: max_results:u32 in 1..=MAX_QUERY_RECORDS,query:string_u32 UTF-8 <= MAX_CATALOG_SEARCH_QUERY_BYTES,Extensions

types.name: catalog_search_entry
types.layout: terminal_handle:u64,generation:u32,score:u32,primary_source:u8,matched_sources:u8,reserved:u16=0,scroll_offset:u64 where 0 means no scrollback jump,context:string_u32 UTF-8 <= MAX_CATALOG_SEARCH_CONTEXT_BYTES; matched_sources uses CATALOG_SEARCH_MATCH_MASK and contains primary source bit

types.name: catalog_search_result
types.layout: flags:u16 CATALOG_SEARCH_RESULT_FLAGS,reserved:u16=0,count:u32 <= MAX_QUERY_RECORDS,repeated CatalogSearchEntry,Extensions; entries rank score descending, the requester's lead terminal first on a tie, then terminal_handle ascending; a deterministic prefix is returned and TRUNCATED is set when max_results or the peer frame limit omits later entries

types.name: journal_result
types.layout: oldest_index:u64,next_index:u64,count:u32,repeated index:u64,generation:u32,flags:u16,reserved:u16=0,exit_code:i32,start_seq:u64,end_seq:u64,started_unix_ms:u64,ended_unix_ms:u64,command:string_u32

types.name: output_result
types.layout: generation:u32,flags:u16,reserved:u16=0,start_seq:u64,start_col:u32,next_seq:u64,next_col:u32,text:bytes_u32

types.name: styled_lines
types.layout: line_count:u32,repeated row:i64,start_col:u32,cell_count:u32,cells:[u8;12]*cell_count,overflow_count:u32,repeated cell_offset:u32,text:string_u32,hyperlink_count:u32,repeated start_col:u32,cell_count:u32,uri:string_u16; line start_col and hyperlink columns are original absolute columns

types.name: query_body
types.layout: delivery:u8,content_kind:u8,encoding:u8,reserved:u8=0,flags:u16,reserved:u16=0,Extensions tags 1 inline_bytes,2 sensitive TransferDescriptor,3 next_cursor,4 total_lines:u64,5 satisfying_state_revision:u64; content kind fixes encoding and next-cursor layout

types.name: query_cursor
types.layout: kind:u8,a:u64,b:u32; READ/OUTPUT next cursor preserves the request cursor kind and exact next coordinate

types.name: query_next_cursor
types.layout: CONTENT_TEXT/STYLED_LINES/TEXT_AND_STYLED uses QueryCursor with READ kind; CONTENT_SEARCH_RESULTS uses QueryCursor kind SEARCH_CURSOR_POSITION with a=oldest-relative row,b=column; CONTENT_OUTPUT always uses QueryCursor kind OUTPUT_CURSOR_SEQUENCE with a=next_seq,b=next_col (COMMAND/LATEST_COMMAND/PROBE normalize and SEQUENCE preserves); CONTENT_JOURNAL is next absolute command index:u64; CONTENT_PATH has no cursor

types.name: text_and_styled
types.layout: plain:bytes_u32 UTF-8,styled:bytes_u32 containing StyledLines

types.name: family_limits
types.layout: ordered optional extensions: tags 1..8 encode max terminals/session:u32,views/session:u32,view rows:u32,view columns:u32,input bytes:u32,inline query bytes:u32,query records:u32,hyperlink URI bytes:u32; all tags are present in a selected family descriptor

types.name: client_record
types.layout: session_id:[u8;16],client_instance:[u8;16],connected_server_ns:u64,idle_ns:u64,bytes_received:u64,bytes_sent:u64,name:string_u16,release:string_u16,label:string_u16,origin:typed_record,Extensions

types.name: origin_unix
types.layout: peer_pid:u32,peer_uid:u32,peer_gid:u32,socket_path:bytes_u32

types.name: origin_ssh
types.layout: remote_address:string_u16,username:string_u16

types.name: origin_edge
types.layout: subject:string_u16,issuer:string_u16

types.name: origin_relay
types.layout: route_handle:u64,generation:u64,depth:u16,reserved:u16=0

types.name: origin_webrtc
types.layout: peer_id:string_u16

types.name: origin_extension
types.layout: extension_id:u64,definition_revision:u64,attempt:u64,task_id:u32,name:string_u16

types.name: active_subscriptions
types.layout: terminal_count:u16,surface_count:u16,aux_count:u16,reserved:u16=0; repeated terminal_handle:u64,view_id:u32,rows:u16,cols:u16; repeated surface_handle:u64,view_id:u32,width:u32,height:u32,scale_120:u16,reserved:u16=0; repeated family:u16,reserved:u16=0,subscription_id:u32,resource_handle:u64; each section strictly key-sorted

types.name: bandwidth_rates
types.layout: ClientRecord/ClientPatch extension tag 2 exact value received_bytes_per_second:u64,sent_bytes_per_second:u64,sample_window_ns:u64; sample_window_ns is nonzero; cumulative bytes_received/bytes_sent remain required in ClientRecord

types.name: auxiliary_subscription_details
types.layout: ClientRecord/ClientPatch extension tag 3 exact value count:u16,reserved:u16=0; repeated family:u16,state_watch_flags:u16,subscription_id:u32,request_flags:u32,resource:bytes_u16; entries strictly sorted by family then subscription_id; entries are an optional diagnostic refinement of matching active_subscriptions auxiliary entries; resource is the family-specific resource identity (the namespace prefix for KV), request_flags are family-specific, and state_watch_flags use StateWatch flags

types.name: family_limits

events.name: REMOTE_INPUT
events.layout: surface_handle:u64,seat_handle:u64,expires_server_ns:u64,input_kind:u8,reserved:u8=0,contact_count:u16,repeated contact_id:u32,x_32_32:i64,y_32_32:i64; POINTER requires exactly one contact with contact_id=0, TOUCH permits 0..MAX_REMOTE_CONTACTS unique contacts

types.name: surface_record
types.layout: surface_handle:u64,revision:u64,parent_handle:u64,app_handle:u64,lifecycle:u8,reserved:u8=0,composite_width:u32,composite_height:u32,logical_width_32_32:i64,logical_height_32_32:i64,application_id:string_u16,title:string_u16,Extensions

types.name: view_result
types.layout: view_id:u32,codec_version:u16,max_inflight_frames:u16,max_encoded_frame:u32,max_decoded_frame:u32,first_sequence:u64,Extensions

types.name: cursor_state
types.layout: kind:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0; NAMED name:string_u16, HIDDEN empty, CUSTOM hotspot_x:i32,hotspot_y:i32,width:u32,height:u32,scale_120:u16,reserved:u16=0,png:bytes_u32 (at most 32768 bytes)

types.name: text_input_state
types.layout: flags:u16,reserved:u16=0,content_hint:u32,content_purpose:u32; when HAS_CURSOR_RECT x:i32,y:i32,width:i32,height:i32

types.name: minimum_size
types.layout: width:u32,height:u32; logical pixels, each at most 2147483647; zero means no minimum on that axis

types.name: text_input_request_revision
types.layout: revision:u64; nonzero last committed text-input enable; retained across caret updates, changes request an input panel for existing viewers; initial snapshots do not request a panel

types.name: view_color_capabilities
types.layout: optional OPEN_VIEW/CONFIGURE_VIEW extension tag 8: capabilities:u8; bit 0 accepts Display-P3 SDR, bit 1 accepts 10-bit AV1 BT.2020/PQ and HDR presentation, bit 2 additionally accepts 10-bit AV1 4:4:4 Profile 1, bit 3 accepts 8-bit AV1 4:4:4, bit 4 accepts H.264 4:4:4; unknown bits are invalid; absent means sRGB SDR; output is described by each frame COLOR_SPACE using H.273 primaries/transfer/matrix and range 0 limited, 1 full; HDR output requires AV1 codec 2 and uses 10 bits, SDR output uses 8 bits

types.name: family_limits
types.layout: ordered optional extensions: tags 1..9 encode max surfaces/session:u32,views/session:u32,view dimension:u32,view pixels:u64,frame rate:u32,inline cursor bytes:u32,remote contacts:u32,app endpoints/session:u32,app endpoint lifetime ns:u64; all tags are present in a selected family descriptor

requests.name: SET_BEGIN
requests.layout: slot:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,operation_id:[u8;16],item_count:u16,repeated mime:string_u16,byte_len:u64,content_hash:[u8;32],initial_receive_credit:u64,Extensions; ResultPrefix + staging_handle:u64,descriptor_count:u16,reserved:u16=0,repeated descriptor:bytes_u32 containing sensitive receiver-to-sender BYTE TransferDescriptor with required upload-stage extension naming the same handle and expiry,Extensions; before SET_COMMIT succeeds, RESET of any returned descriptor discards the whole stage and all sibling descriptors

requests.name: GET
requests.layout: target_kind:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,slot target slot:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,revision:u64 or drag target drag_handle:u64,revision:u64,item_index:u16,reserved:u16=0,initial_receive_credit:u64,mime:string_u16,Extensions; ResultPrefix + InlineOrTransfer

requests.name: DRAG_BEGIN
requests.layout: operation_id:[u8;16],source_actions:u16,item_count:u16,repeated name:string_u16,mime_count:u16,repeated mime:string_u16,Extensions; name may be empty to mean UNKNOWN until DRAG_DROP; ResultPrefix + drag_handle:u64,revision:u64

requests.name: DRAG_DROP
requests.layout: drag_handle:u64,revision:u64,operation_id:[u8;16],selected_action:u16,reserved:u16=0,Extensions; required DRAG_DROP_ITEMS_EXTENSION value item_count:u16,repeated name:string_u16,selected_mime:string_u16 atomically supplies final names and the exact offered MIME to fetch for every item; ResultPrefix completes only after all corresponding GET bodies validate

types.name: inline_item
types.layout: mime:string_u16,data:bytes_u32; MIME nonempty and at most 255 bytes, entries strictly ordered by MIME, total encoded item bytes at most 32768

types.name: upload_item
types.layout: mime:string_u16,byte_len:u64,content_hash:[u8;32],initial_receive_credit:u64; entries strictly ordered by MIME

types.name: drag_item
types.layout: name:string_u16,mime_count:u16,repeated mime:string_u16; name is at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes and may be empty to mean UNKNOWN until DRAG_DROP; MIME values nonempty, unique, and strictly ordered

types.name: drag_drop_items_extension
types.layout: required extension tag 1 value item_count:u16,repeated name:string_u16,selected_mime:string_u16; count 1..256 must equal the current drag item count, each name is at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes and each selected MIME is nonempty, at most 255 UTF-8 bytes, and present in that item's offer; the server fetches exactly one body per item in index order and applies all final names and bodies atomically before the drop

types.name: selection_record
types.layout: slot:u8,owner_kind:u8,reserved:u16=0,owner_handle:u64,revision:u64,mime_count:u16,repeated mime:string_u16,Extensions

types.name: drag_record
types.layout: drag_handle:u64,revision:u64,owner_session:[u8;16],source_actions:u16,selected_action:u16,target_surface:u64,item_count:u16,repeated name:string_u16,mime_count:u16,repeated mime:string_u16,Extensions

types.name: state_entity_body
types.layout: entity_kind:u16,reserved:u16=0; ADD/REPLACE complete selection_record or drag_record; PATCH entity key then Extensions; REMOVE slot:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,revision:u64 or drag_handle:u64,revision:u64

types.name: family_limits
types.layout: ordered optional extensions: tags 1..7 encode max inline bytes:u32,items:u32,MIME bytes:u32,item name bytes:u32,active drags/session:u32,stages/session:u32,staged bytes/stage:u64; all tags are present in a selected family descriptor

requests.name: WATCH
requests.layout: StateWatch; optional extension tag 1 contains datasets:u8 (bit0 tray, bit1 notifications), absent defaults to both; ResultPrefix + StateWatchResult

requests.name: TRAY_ACTION
requests.layout: tray_handle:u64,tray_revision:u64,menu_revision:u64,operation_id:[u8;16],action_kind:u8,flags:u8,reserved:u16=0,value:i32,item_handle:u64,Extensions; ResultPrefix; MENU_ITEM requires nonzero menu_revision and item_handle; all other kinds require both zero; only SCROLL accepts flags/value and value is nonzero

requests.name: NOTIFICATION_ACTION
requests.layout: notification_handle:u64,revision:u64,action_kind:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,action_handle:u64,operation_id:[u8;16],reply:string_u32,Extensions; ResultPrefix; action_handle is nonzero iff ACTION and reply is valid only for ACTION

types.name: tray_record
types.layout: tray_handle:u64,revision:u64,menu_revision:u64,status:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,title:string_u16,icon_hash:[u8;32],Extensions

types.name: notification_record
types.layout: notification_handle:u64,revision:u64,flags:u16,urgency:u8,reserved:u8=0,expires_server_ns:u64,application:string_u16,summary:string_u16,body:string_u32,action_count:u16,repeated action_handle:u64,label:string_u16,Extensions; extension tag 1 content_image_hash:[u8;32], tag 2 application_icon_hash:[u8;32], tag 3 notification_progress, tag 4 notification_reply; HAS_PROGRESS/HAS_REPLY flags are set iff their extensions are present

types.name: state_entity_body
types.layout: entity_kind:u16,reserved:u16=0; ADD/REPLACE complete tray_record or notification_record; PATCH entity handle:u64,revision:u64,Extensions, with notification tags 1..4 using their complete codecs and a zero-byte value clearing that field; REMOVE tray handle:u64,revision:u64; REMOVE notification handle:u64,revision:u64,close_reason:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0

types.name: notification_progress
types.layout: value:u32,maximum:u32; maximum is nonzero and value <= maximum

types.name: notification_reply
types.layout: placeholder:string_u16

types.name: notification_close_reason
types.layout: u8: EXPIRED=1, DISMISSED=2, CLOSED_BY_CALLER=3, UNDEFINED=4

types.name: watch_datasets
types.layout: StateWatch extension tag 1 value datasets:u8 where bit0 tray, bit1 notifications; absent defaults to both

types.name: menu_tree
types.layout: tray_handle:u64,tray_revision:u64,menu_revision:u64,node_count:u32,repeated node:bytes_u32,Extensions; nodes preorder and parent-before-child

types.name: menu_node
types.layout: node_handle:u64,parent_handle:u64,kind:u8,flags:u8,reserved:u16=0,position:u32,action_handle:u64,label:string_u16,shortcut:string_u16,icon_hash:[u8;32],Extensions

types.name: family_limits
types.layout: ordered optional extensions: tags 1..6 encode max tray items:u32,notifications:u32,menu nodes:u32,notification actions:u32,inline menu bytes:u32,inline asset bytes:u32; all tags are present in a selected family descriptor

requests.name: OPEN_OUTPUT
requests.layout: device_handle:u64,format_count:u16,reserved:u16=0,repeated MediaFormat,latency_target_ns:u64,target_bitrate_kbps:u16,reserved:u16=0,Extensions; target_bitrate_kbps is 0 for server default or 1..=MAX_OUTPUT_BITRATE_KBPS; ResultPrefix + stream_handle:u64,selected_format:MediaFormat

requests.name: PORTAL_REPLY
requests.layout: portal_handle:u64,revision:u64,operation_id:[u8;16],kind:u16,decision:u8,reserved:u8=0,metadata:bytes_u32 containing kind/decision-specific PortalReplyMetadata,Extensions; ResultPrefix; DENY and CANCEL require empty metadata

requests.name: PORTAL_CLOSE
requests.layout: portal_handle:u64,revision:u64,operation_id:[u8;16],Extensions; ResultPrefix; idempotent by operation_id; closes pending or granted portal and releases every granted stream

events.name: FRAME
events.layout: stream_handle:u64,sequence:u64,capture_time:u64,presentation_time:u64,codec_version:u16,flags:u16,fragment_index:u16,fragment_count:u16,complete_len:u32,payload:remaining; audio capture_time and nonzero presentation_time are sample positions at the selected MediaFormat.sample_rate from the server media-session epoch, while video values are nanoseconds from that same epoch; presentation_time 0 means use capture_time

events.name: PLAYOUT_REPORT
events.layout: stream_handle:u64,consumed_sequence:u64,audio_video_delay_ns:u64; measured client-side difference between audible audio and visible video presentation latency

types.name: media_format
types.layout: codec:u16,channels:u16,sample_rate:u32,width:u32,height:u32,frame_rate_milli:u32,Extensions

types.name: device_record
types.layout: device_handle:u64,revision:u64,kind:u8,state:u8,flags:u16,name:string_u16,format_count:u16,repeated MediaFormat,Extensions

types.name: lease_record
types.layout: lease_handle:u64,revision:u64,device_handle:u64,owner_session:[u8;16],lifecycle:u8,reserved:[u8;7]=0,expires_server_ns:u64,Extensions

types.name: portal_record
types.layout: portal_handle:u64,revision:u64,kind:u16,state:u16,owner_session:[u8;16],metadata:bytes_u32 containing PortalRecordMetadata,Extensions; PENDING contains request metadata, GRANTED contains PortalGrantedMetadata, DENIED/CANCELLED/WITHDRAWN require empty metadata

types.name: portal_choice_value
types.layout: id:string_u16,value:string_u16; IDs and values are nonempty UTF-8 without NUL

types.name: portal_choice
types.layout: id:string_u16,label:string_u16,initial:string_u16,option_count:u16,reserved:u16=0,repeated option:bytes_u32 containing PortalChoiceValue; option IDs are unique and nonempty initial names one option

types.name: portal_access_request_metadata
types.layout: deadline_server_ns:u64,parent_surface_handle:u64 (zero means absent),app_id:string_u16,title:string_u16,subtitle:string_u16,body:string_u32,deny_label:string_u16,grant_label:string_u16,icon_name:string_u16,choice_count:u16,reserved:u16=0,repeated choice:bytes_u32 containing PortalChoice

types.name: portal_screencast_candidate
types.layout: surface_handle:u64,width:u32,height:u32,title:string_u16,app_id:string_u16,thumbnail_hash_present:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,optional thumbnail_hash:[u8;32]; thumbnail bytes are fetched through FETCH_ASSET

types.name: portal_screencast_request_metadata
types.layout: deadline_server_ns:u64,parent_surface_handle:u64 (zero means absent),app_id:string_u16,multiple:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,candidate_count:u16,reserved:u16=0,repeated candidate:bytes_u32 containing PortalScreenCastCandidate

types.name: portal_access_grant_metadata
types.layout: choice_count:u16,reserved:u16=0,repeated chosen:bytes_u32 containing PortalChoiceValue; IDs are unique

types.name: portal_screencast_grant_metadata
types.layout: surface_count:u16,reserved:u16=0,repeated surface_handle:u64; handles are nonzero and unique

types.name: portal_screencast_granted_stream
types.layout: surface_handle:u64,stream_handle:u64; both nonzero; surface and stream handles are unique within one grant

types.name: portal_screencast_granted_metadata
types.layout: stream_count:u16,reserved:u16=0,repeated PortalScreenCastGrantedStream; these are the live streams released by PORTAL_CLOSE

types.name: portal_reply_metadata
types.layout: GRANT ACCESS uses PortalAccessGrantMetadata; GRANT SCREENCAST uses PortalScreenCastGrantMetadata; DENY and CANCEL are exactly zero bytes

types.name: portal_granted_metadata
types.layout: GRANTED ACCESS uses PortalAccessGrantMetadata; GRANTED SCREENCAST uses PortalScreenCastGrantedMetadata with allocated stream handles

types.name: portal_record_metadata
types.layout: PENDING uses kind-specific request metadata; GRANTED uses PortalGrantedMetadata; DENIED, CANCELLED, and WITHDRAWN are exactly zero bytes

types.name: player_record
types.layout: player_handle:u64,revision:u64,state:u16,flags:u16,position_us:i64,duration_us:i64,identity:string_u16,desktop_entry:string_u16,title:string_u16,artist:string_u16,album:string_u16,Extensions

types.name: state_entity_body
types.layout: entity_kind:u16,reserved:u16=0; ADD/REPLACE complete device_record,lease_record,portal_record,or player_record; PATCH entity handle:u64,revision:u64,Extensions; REMOVE entity handle:u64,revision:u64

types.name: asset_delivery
types.layout: InlineOrTransfer with Desktop-like content-addressed asset; inline at most 32768, Transfer family Media kind 1 version 1

types.name: family_limits
types.layout: ordered optional extensions: tags 1..14 encode max devices:u32,leases/session:u32,streams/session:u32,portals/session:u32,players:u32,formats:u32,inline metadata bytes:u32,inline asset bytes:u32,portal metadata bytes:u32,portal string bytes:u32,portal body bytes:u32,portal choices:u32,portal choice options:u32,screencast candidates:u32; all tags are present in a selected family descriptor

types.name: family_record
types.layout: font_handle:u64,generation:u64,flags:u16,face_count:u16,family:string_u16,display:string_u16,Extensions

types.name: description
types.layout: family:string_u16,face_count:u16,repeated face_record:bytes_u32,Extensions

types.name: face_record
types.layout: face_handle:u64,content_hash:[u8;32],byte_len:u64,format:u8,style:u8,face_flags:u16,weight_range:[u16;3],stretch_range:[u16;3],slant:i16,units_per_em:u16,metrics:[i32;4],subfamily:string_u16,postscript:string_u16,Extensions

types.name: family_limits
types.layout: extension tags 1 max_families:u32,2 max_faces_per_family:u32,3 max_description_bytes:u64,4 max_face_bytes:u64,5 max_concurrent_fetches:u32,6 max_scan_duration_ns:u64,7 refresh_interval_ns:u64

requests.name: CLOSE
requests.layout: root_handle:u64,Extensions; ResultPrefix; idempotent and invalidates root-scoped watches/stages

requests.name: FETCH
requests.layout: root_handle:u64,path:bytes_u32 containing WirePath,expected_hash_present:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,optional expected_hash:[u8;32],initial_receive_credit:u64,Extensions; ResultPrefix + content:bytes_u32 containing InlineOrTransfer,Extensions

requests.name: STAGE_WRITE
requests.layout: root_handle:u64,path:bytes_u32 containing WirePath,precondition:bytes_u32 containing Precondition,flags:u16,reserved:u16=0,mode:u32,byte_len:u64,content_hash:[u8;32],initial_receive_credit:u64,Extensions; ResultPrefix + staging_handle:u64,descriptor:bytes_u32 containing sensitive receiver-to-sender BYTE TransferDescriptor with required upload-stage extension naming that handle,Extensions; before COMMIT succeeds, RESET of the returned descriptor discards the stage; a CONFLICT ResultPrefix detail Extensions contains optional tag RESULT_CONFLICT_DETAIL_EXTENSION with exact ConflictDetail value

requests.name: COMMIT
requests.layout: staging_handle:u64,operation_id:[u8;16],flags:u16,reserved:u16=0,Extensions; ResultPrefix + root_revision:u64,entry_revision:u64,modified_unix_ns:i64,content_hash:[u8;32]; a CONFLICT ResultPrefix detail Extensions contains optional tag RESULT_CONFLICT_DETAIL_EXTENSION with exact ConflictDetail value

events.name: STATE
events.layout: StateEvent<EntryRecord|EntryPatch|RemoveRecord|MoveRecord>; known family record kinds includes RECORD_MOVE

types.name: wire_path
types.layout: component_count:u16,repeated component:bytes_u16; root is zero components; components are raw platform-name bytes, nonempty, not dot/dot-dot, without NUL or separators; at most 1024 components, 4096 bytes each, 65535 bytes total

types.name: root_source
types.layout: kind:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0; PLATFORM_PATH path:bytes_u32, TERMINAL_CWD terminal_handle:u64,suffix:bytes_u32 containing WirePath, PROCESS_CWD process_handle:u64, STAGING no body; STAGING is session-owned, created lazily, and survives root CLOSE until session loss

types.name: entry_record
types.layout: path:bytes_u32 containing WirePath,entry_revision:u64,kind:u8,flags:u8,reserved:u16=0,mode:u32,modified_unix_ns:i64; FILE byte_len:u64,content_hash:[u8;32],content_kind:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,optional content:bytes_u32; DIRECTORY no body; SYMLINK content_hash:[u8;32],target:bytes_u32 where hash is BLAKE3(target); Extensions

types.name: entry_patch
types.layout: path:bytes_u32 containing WirePath,observed_revision:u64,fields:u16,reserved:u16=0,replacement:bytes_u32 containing complete EntryRecord with identical path; fields states which semantic fields changed

types.name: move_record
types.layout: from:bytes_u32 containing WirePath,to:bytes_u32 containing WirePath,operation_id_present:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,optional operation_id:[u8;16]

types.name: remove_record
types.layout: path:bytes_u32 containing WirePath,removed_revision:u64,operation_id_present:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,optional operation_id:[u8;16]

types.name: typed_record
types.layout: record_len:u32,kind:u16,flags:u16,body; record_len includes kind and flags; flag bit0 REQUIRED, other bits zero

types.name: query_page
types.layout: next_cursor:bytes_u16,total_hint:u64,flags:u16,reserved:u16=0,delivery:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0; INLINE record_count:u16,reserved:u16=0,record_stream:bytes_u32; TRANSFER descriptor:bytes_u32 containing sensitive server-to-client MESSAGE TransferDescriptor; Extensions

types.name: query_read_record
types.layout: question_index:u16,status:u16,path_present:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,optional path:bytes_u32 containing WirePath,content:bytes_u32; OK content follows the matching question kind: STAT EntryRecord, HASH exactly [u8;32], LINK_TARGET raw target bytes, CONTENT raw file bytes; non-OK content is empty

types.name: query_path_record
types.layout: path:bytes_u32 containing WirePath,flags:u16,reserved:u16=0; used by SEARCH and INDEX

types.name: query_grep_file_record
types.layout: file_index:u32,match_count:u32,flags:u16,reserved:u16=0,path:bytes_u32 containing WirePath; file indices are dense from zero

types.name: query_grep_match_record
types.layout: file_index:u32,line:u32,column:u32,end_line:u32,end_column:u32,text:string_u32; lines and UTF-8 byte columns are zero based and end is exclusive

types.name: query_record_batch
types.layout: nonempty Transfer MESSAGE item: first_record_index:u32,record_count:u16,reserved:u16=0,record_stream:bytes_u32 containing typed records; batches are contiguous from index zero and collectively contain the QueryPage record sequence

types.name: precondition
types.layout: kind:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0; ANY/ABSENT no body, REVISION revision:u64, HASH content_hash:[u8;32]

types.name: apply_item
types.layout: outer item_flags bit0 CREATE_PARENTS is valid for WRITE_INLINE,MKDIR,RENAME,SYMLINK,HARDLINK and forbidden for REMOVE; WRITE_INLINE path,precondition,mode:u32,content:bytes_u32; MKDIR path,precondition,mode:u32; REMOVE path,precondition,flags:u16,reserved:u16=0; RENAME from,to,precondition; SYMLINK path,target:bytes_u32,precondition; HARDLINK source,target,precondition; all path/precondition values are bytes_u32 encoded

types.name: apply_item_result
types.layout: index:u16,status:u16,entry_revision:u64,modified_unix_ns:i64,content_hash_present:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,optional content_hash:[u8;32],detail:string_u16; on CONFLICT revision/hash/time describe the current entry and are zero/absent when it is absent

types.name: conflict_detail
types.layout: path:bytes_u32 containing WirePath,current_present:u8,hash_present:u8,reserved:u16=0,current_entry_revision:u64,modified_unix_ns:i64,optional content_hash:[u8;32]; exact value of optional Core ResultPrefix detail extension tag RESULT_CONFLICT_DETAIL_EXTENSION for STAGE_WRITE or COMMIT status CONFLICT

types.name: entry_operation_id_extension
types.layout: EntryRecord extension tag 1 exact value operation_id:[u8;16], nonzero; lets watchers recognize mutation echoes without suppressing them

types.name: family_limits
types.layout: ordered optional extensions: tags 1..12 encode max roots/session:u32,watches/root:u32,path components:u32,component bytes:u32,path bytes:u32,inline bytes:u32,query records:u32,query bytes:u32,stages/session:u32,staged bytes:u64,batch items:u32,query concurrency:u32

requests.name: OPEN
requests.layout: source:bytes_u32 containing RepositorySource,Extensions; ResultPrefix + repository_handle:u64,repository_revision:u64,object_algorithm:u8,reserved:u8=0,repository_flags:u16,canonical_worktree_path:bytes_u32 empty only for BARE,canonical_git_dir:bytes_u32 nonempty,Extensions

requests.name: CLOSE
requests.layout: repository_handle:u64,Extensions; ResultPrefix; idempotent and releases repository-scoped watches

requests.name: WATCH
requests.layout: repository_handle:u64,datasets:u16,reserved:u16=0,state:bytes_u32 containing StateWatch whose Extensions contain WatchOptions; ResultPrefix + StateWatchResult

requests.name: QUERY
requests.layout: repository_handle:u64,max_records:u16,reserved:u16=0,cursor:bytes_u16 containing QueryCursor,initial_receive_credit:u64,body:bytes_u32 containing QueryBody,Extensions; ResultPrefix + QueryPage; max_records zero selects the server default and a nonzero value is bounded by negotiated max_query_records; repository_handle is zero exactly for DISCOVER and nonzero otherwise

requests.name: WATCH_QUERY
requests.layout: repository_handle:u64,max_records:u16,reserved:u16=0,body:bytes_u32 containing QueryBody,state:bytes_u32 containing StateWatch; ResultPrefix + StateWatchResult; max_records has the same zero-default and hard-bound semantics as QUERY and bounds every replacement page; immutable variants may return UNSUPPORTED; StateWatch initial_credit accounts complete inline QUERY_STATE events and is not Transfer credit

events.name: QUERY_STATE
events.layout: query_subscription_id:u32,event:bytes_u32 containing StateEvent<WatchedQueryValue>; outer ID is nonzero and MUST equal event.subscription_id; SNAPSHOT_RECORDS has exactly one ADD record and DELTA exactly one REPLACE record, each body is a WatchedQueryValue; marker phases have no records; Transfer delivery is forbidden because StateWatch credit accounts the complete event

events.name: QUERY_STATE_ACK
events.layout: StateAck; subscription_id is the same ID carried by both QUERY_STATE outer prefix and inner StateEvent, allocated by WATCH_QUERY

events.name: CLOSED
events.layout: repository_handle:u64,repository_revision:u64,reason:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,detail:string_u16; terminal server-side lifecycle notification; clients invalidate the repository, its watches, and its watched queries before dispatching the event

types.name: object_id
types.layout: algorithm:u8,byte_len:u8,reserved:u16=0,bytes:[u8;byte_len]; SHA1 requires 20 bytes and SHA256 requires 32 bytes; zero bytes are not a sentinel

types.name: repository_source
types.layout: kind:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0; PLATFORM_PATH path:bytes_u32 raw platform bytes; FS root_handle:u64,path:bytes_u32 containing FS WirePath; SUBMODULE parent_repository:u64,path:bytes_u32 containing non-root FS WirePath; TERMINAL_CWD terminal_handle:u64,suffix:bytes_u32 containing relative FS WirePath, resolved atomically from that terminal's live cwd

types.name: watch_options
types.layout: StateWatch Extensions: optional tag WATCH_REFS_SETTLE_MS_EXTENSION value u16 milliseconds (0 server default), optional tag WATCH_STATUS_SETTLE_MS_EXTENSION value u16 milliseconds (0 server default), optional tag WATCH_REF_PREFIXES_EXTENSION value count:u16 followed by unique strictly raw-byte-ascending prefix:bytes_u16 entries; empty/absent prefix list means every ref

types.name: watch_status_selection
types.layout: Additional optional Git WATCH StateWatch extension: tag WATCH_STATUS_SELECTION_EXTENSION, REQUIRED clear, value exactly one u8 of flags admitting WATCH_STATUS_UNTRACKED and WATCH_STATUS_IGNORED in addition to tracked status; unknown bits are invalid and IGNORED requires UNTRACKED, so valid values are 0, 1, and 3. Absence admits both classes for compatibility; selection only applies with the WATCH_STATUS dataset and is enforced before collection budgets. Older servers may ignore this optional extension

types.name: query_endpoint
types.layout: kind:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,object_present:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,optional object:ObjectId; COMMIT,TREE,MERGE_BASE require object; EMPTY,INDEX,WORKTREE forbid object; MERGE_BASE is valid only as the left endpoint

types.name: query_cursor
types.layout: empty bytes mean START; otherwise kind:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0 and variant body: LOG_FRONTIER count:u16,reserved:u16=0,repeated ObjectId; PATH path:bytes_u32 containing FS WirePath; PLATFORM_PATH path:bytes_u32 raw platform bytes; PATCH path:bytes_u32 containing FS WirePath,position:u64; POSITION position:u64. Cursors are emitted by the server and replayed unchanged, but their exact form permits faithful protocol adaptation

types.name: query_body
types.layout: kind:u16,flags:u16=0,variant body; RESOLVE spec:bytes_u16; MERGE_BASE object_count:u16,reserved:u16=0,repeated ordered ObjectId where 2 <= object_count <= MAX_QUERY_ENDPOINTS and the result is the best common ancestor of the complete set rather than an associative pairwise reduction; LOG query_flags:u16,reserved:u16=0,spec:bytes_u16,tip_count:u16,hide_count:u16,repeated tips:ObjectId,repeated hides:ObjectId,path:bytes_u32 empty or FS WirePath, where nonempty spec forbids explicit tips/hides and empty spec with no tips means HEAD; TREE tree:ObjectId,path:bytes_u32 FS WirePath; BLOB query_flags:u16,reserved:u16=0,object:ObjectId,path:bytes_u32 empty or FS WirePath,offset:u64,max_bytes:u32; DIFF query_flags:u16,rename_threshold:u8,reserved:u8=0,left:QueryEndpoint,right:QueryEndpoint,path:bytes_u32 empty or FS WirePath; PATCH query_flags:u16,context_lines:u8,rename_threshold:u8,max_bytes:u32,left:QueryEndpoint,right:QueryEndpoint,path:bytes_u32 empty or FS WirePath and returns the patch transforming left into right; INDEX query_flags:u16,reserved:u16=0,path:bytes_u32 empty or FS WirePath; DISCOVER query_flags:u16,max_depth:u16,source:bytes_u32 containing RepositorySource; BLAME query_flags:u16,reserved:u16=0,object:ObjectId,path:bytes_u32 FS WirePath,start_line:u32 one-based,line_count:u32 where zero means through end; REFLOG query_flags:u16,reserved:u16=0,name:bytes_u16 empty meaning HEAD; WORKTREES empty

types.name: typed_query_record
types.layout: record_len:u32,record_kind:u16,record_flags:u16,body; length includes kind and flags; flag bit0 REQUIRED; known bodies are ObjectRecord, CommitRecord, TreeEntryRecord, ContentRecord, DiffRecord, IndexEntryRecord, DiscoveryRecord, BlameRecord, ReflogRecord, WorktreeRecord, LogPathRecord, PatchFileRecord, PatchRowRecord, PatchGapRecord, PatchBaseRecord; unknown optional records are skipped and unknown required records fail the containing operation

types.name: object_record
types.layout: role:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,object:ObjectId; RESOLVE emits TIP then HIDE records preserving specification order, MERGE_BASE emits RESULT

types.name: query_page
types.layout: next_cursor:bytes_u16 containing QueryCursor,total_hint:u64,flags:u16,reserved:u16=0,delivery:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0; MORE is set exactly when next_cursor is nonempty; INLINE record_count:u16,reserved:u16=0,record_stream:bytes_u32; TRANSFER descriptor:bytes_u32 containing sensitive server-to-client MESSAGE TransferDescriptor with content kind QUERY_CONTENT_KIND; Extensions; ordinary QUERY permits either delivery, watched QUERY_STATE requires INLINE. For LOG, next_cursor is LOG_FRONTIER and preserves the frontier exactly; watched LOG pages are complete replacements whose MORE flag/frontier are interpreted identically to one-shot LOG pages

types.name: watched_query_value
types.layout: query_status:u16 using Core status codes,reserved:u16=0,detail:string_u32,page:bytes_u32 empty or containing QueryPage; OK requires empty detail and one INLINE page; non-OK requires nonempty detail and an empty page; a later REPLACE with OK represents recovery without terminating the subscription

types.name: commit_record
types.layout: flags:u16,reserved:u16=0,object:ObjectId,tree:ObjectId,parent_count:u16,reserved:u16=0,repeated parent:ObjectId,authored_unix_seconds:i64,author_timezone_minutes:i16,committed_unix_seconds:i64,committer_timezone_minutes:i16,author_name:bytes_u16,author_email:bytes_u16,committer_name:bytes_u16,committer_email:bytes_u16,message:bytes_u32; identity and message bytes may be non-UTF8 and LOSSY_ENCODING reports that a bridge substituted text

types.name: log_path_record
types.layout: entry_kind:u8,object_present:u8,reserved:u16=0,mode:u32,optional object:ObjectId,path:bytes_u32 containing non-root FS WirePath; emitted immediately after its CommitRecord when LOG_PATH_OIDS is requested; absence means the followed path is deleted at that commit and requires entry_kind=BLOB,mode=0

types.name: tree_entry_record
types.layout: entry_kind:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,mode:u32,name:bytes_u16,object:ObjectId

types.name: content_record
types.layout: object:ObjectId,byte_len:u64,offset:u64,next_offset:u64,delivery:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0; delivered length is next_offset-offset and next_offset<=byte_len; INLINE bytes:bytes_u32 bounded by MAX_INLINE_BYTES and exact delivered length; TRANSFER descriptor:bytes_u32 containing sensitive server-to-client BYTE TransferDescriptor and the sender sends exactly the delivered length before CLOSE; BLOB and PATCH use distinct content kinds

types.name: diff_record
types.layout: status:u8,similarity_percent:u8,flags:u16,old_path:bytes_u32 empty or FS WirePath,new_path:bytes_u32 empty or FS WirePath,old_mode:u32,new_mode:u32,old_object_present:u8,new_object_present:u8,reserved:u16=0,optional old_object:ObjectId,optional new_object:ObjectId; BINARY,SUBMODULE,FILTERED preserve diff classification

types.name: patch_file_record
types.layout: status:u8,similarity_percent:u8,flags:u16,old_path:bytes_u32 empty or non-root FS WirePath,new_path:bytes_u32 empty or non-root FS WirePath; begins a structured file section and preserves added/modified/deleted/renamed/copied plus BINARY/FILTERED; at least one path is nonempty

types.name: patch_row_record
types.layout: old_line:u32,new_line:u32,old_text:bytes_u32,new_text:bytes_u32,old_span_count:u16,reserved:u16=0,repeated old_span:{start:u32,length:u32},new_span_count:u16,reserved:u16=0,repeated new_span:{start:u32,length:u32}; line numbers are one-based and zero means that side is absent; at least one side exists; spans are sorted, non-overlapping byte ranges bounded by their side's text and capped by MAX_PATCH_SPANS

types.name: patch_gap_record
types.layout: old_line:u32,new_line:u32; hunk elision/cursor coordinates, one-based with at least one nonzero

types.name: patch_base_record
types.layout: object:ObjectId; effective merge base used for the structured patch

types.name: index_entry_record
types.layout: stage:u8,status:u8,flags:u16,path:bytes_u32 containing non-root FS WirePath,mode:u32,size:u64,modified_unix_ns:i64,object:ObjectId; stage is 0..3 and flags preserve conflicted,intent-to-add,skip-worktree

types.name: discovery_record
types.layout: flags:u16,reserved:u16=0,object_algorithm:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,worktree_path:bytes_u32 raw platform bytes empty iff BARE,git_dir:bytes_u32 nonempty raw canonical platform bytes; results are deduplicated by git_dir

types.name: blame_record
types.layout: flags:u16,reserved:u16=0,start_line:u32 one-based,end_line_exclusive:u32,original_start_line:u32 one-based,commit:ObjectId,original_path:bytes_u32 containing FS WirePath empty only when unchanged,author:bytes_u16,summary:bytes_u16

types.name: reflog_record
types.layout: flags:u16,reserved:u16=0,index:u64,old_object:ObjectId,new_object:ObjectId,committer:bytes_u16,committed_unix_seconds:i64,timezone_minutes:i16,reserved:u16=0,message:bytes_u32

types.name: worktree_record
types.layout: flags:u16,reserved:u16=0,path:bytes_u32 raw platform bytes empty iff BARE,head_present:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,optional head:ObjectId,branch:bytes_u16 full ref name empty iff DETACHED or BARE,lock_reason:string_u16 empty unless LOCKED

types.name: fetch_ref_result
types.layout: flags:u16,status:u16,old_present:u8,new_present:u8,reserved:u16=0,optional old:ObjectId,optional new:ObjectId,name:bytes_u16,detail:string_u16; PRUNED requires no new object, NEW requires no old object, status uses Core status codes

types.name: entity_record
types.layout: entity_kind:u16,reserved:u16=0,key:bytes_u16,entity_revision:u64,body:bytes_u32 containing exact EntityBody,Extensions; ADD and REPLACE use the complete record; HEAD key is ASCII HEAD, OPERATION key is ASCII operation, REF/REMOTE/UPSTREAM keys are their raw nonempty names, STATUS key is an encoded non-root FS WirePath, STASH key is its little-endian u32 index, WORKTREE_GENERATION key is ASCII worktrees

types.name: head_entity_body
types.layout: flags:u16,reserved:u16=0,object_present:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,optional object:ObjectId,symbolic_target:bytes_u16; DETACHED requires object and empty target, UNBORN requires no object and nonempty target, otherwise object and nonempty target

types.name: ref_entity_body
types.layout: flags:u16,reserved:u16=0,object:ObjectId,peeled_present:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,optional peeled:ObjectId,symbolic_target:bytes_u16; PEELED and SYMBOLIC flags exactly match optional peeled and nonempty target

types.name: remote_entity_body
types.layout: flags:u16,reserved:u16=0,fetch_url:bytes_u32,push_url:bytes_u32; URLs are raw configured bytes, each bounded by MAX_REMOTE_BYTES, and push_url is empty when equal to fetch_url

types.name: operation_entity_body
types.layout: operation_kind:u8,flags:u8,reserved:u16=0,head_present:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,optional head:ObjectId,detail:string_u16; HEAD_PRESENT exactly matches the optional object

types.name: status_entity_body
types.layout: index_status:u8,worktree_status:u8,flags:u16,content_present:u8,old_path_present:u8,reserved:u16=0,optional content:ObjectId,optional old_path:bytes_u32 containing non-root FS WirePath; CONTENT_PRESENT and OLD_PATH_PRESENT flags exactly match their optional values; current path is the EntityRecord key

types.name: upstream_entity_body
types.layout: flags:u16,reserved:u16=0,ahead:u32,behind:u32,upstream:bytes_u16; EntityRecord key is the local branch's full ref name; GONE requires zero counts and forbids COUNTS_VALID, otherwise COUNTS_VALID says ahead/behind are complete under the walk budget

types.name: stash_entity_body
types.layout: object:ObjectId,created_unix_seconds:i64,timezone_minutes:i16,reserved:u16=0,message:bytes_u32; EntityRecord key is the little-endian u32 N of stash@{N}

types.name: worktree_generation_entity_body
types.layout: count:u32,reserved:u32=0,digest:u64; the order-independent worktree-set generation; EntityRecord key is ASCII worktrees and clients refetch QUERY WORKTREES whenever count or digest changes

types.name: entity_patch
types.layout: entity_kind:u16,reserved:u16=0,key:bytes_u16,observed_revision:u64,fields:u32,replacement:bytes_u32 containing complete EntityRecord with identical kind/key,Extensions

types.name: removed_entity

codecs.name: media-av1-v1

codecs.name: media-h264-v1

codecs.name: media-mjpeg-v1
codecs.layout: One complete JPEG interchange datastream from SOI through EOI. Every frame is independently decodable and sets FRAME_KEYFRAME.

codecs.name: media-opus-v1
codecs.layout: packet_count:u16,reserved:u16=0,repeated packet_len:u16,packet:packet_len. Packets are complete Opus packets in decode order, nonempty, and together cover one Media FRAME duration; sample rate on the wire is 48000.

codecs.name: media-pcm-f32le-v1
codecs.layout: Interleaved IEEE-754 binary32 little-endian samples in MediaFormat channel order; finite values are in [-1,1], negative zero is canonicalized to positive zero, and payload length is a nonzero multiple of channels*4. One FRAME payload contains complete sample frames and no codec-local header.

codecs.name: media-pcm-s16le-v1
codecs.layout: Interleaved signed 16-bit little-endian samples in MediaFormat channel order; payload length is a nonzero multiple of channels*2. One FRAME payload contains complete sample frames and no codec-local header.

codecs.name: media-vp9-v1
codecs.layout: One complete VP9 frame in unframed elementary-stream form. Decoder configuration is derived from key frames; superframes are permitted only when their index and every contained frame fit the negotiated complete_len.

codecs.layout: metadata_count:u8,reserved:[u8;3]=0,repeated tag:u16,flags:u16,len:u32,body:len; temporal_unit:remaining. Metadata is unique and tag-ordered. COLOR_SPACE body is primaries:u8,transfer:u8,matrix:u8,range:u8. DAMAGE body is rect_count:u16,reserved:u16=0,repeated x:u32,y:u32,width:u32,height:u32. Temporal unit uses AV1 low-overhead OBU format and contains a temporal delimiter.
